hypothesis: Two unresolved effects may be mixed: an eight-element cleanup path within 16-element vector remainders, and key processing repeated per query block. These features test both directly.

pcvs.name: query_elements
pcvs.rationale: Tracks linear query and output processing.

pcvs.name: key_remainder_16
pcvs.rationale: Tracks remainder processing after full 16-element key vectors.

pcvs.name: key_remainder_8
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether eight-element vectors handle part of the 16-element remainder, leaving a separate scalar tail.

pcvs.name: keys_per_query_block
pcvs.rationale: Tracks key processing repeated for each 32-row query block, including the interaction omitted by a standalone query-block count.
